question: In a certain code language. ‘GLOAT' is coded as 'EJMYR' and ‘INCUR' is coded as ‘GLASP’. What is the code for 'PANDA' in the given code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : (2) is subtracted the position value according to the English alphabetic series. So, • ‘GLOAT' is coded as 'EJMYR'
